Title: Mark single attendance with valid employeeId and absent status
Description: Verify that marking attendance for a single employee with valid employeeId and absent status returns 200 OK and the saved attendance record
Pre-Conditions: Employee with employeeId exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing employeeId and absent
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with matching employeeId and absent status
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record saved for employeeId 123 with absent=true and date as current date

Title: Mark single attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify that marking attendance without employeeId returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body missing employeeId
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark single attendance with missing absent field

Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark batch attendance with valid payload
Description: Verify that marking batch attendance with valid list of attendance DTOs returns 200 OK with correct counts and saved records
Pre-Conditions: Employees with given employeeIds exist in the system
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array of valid attendance DTOs
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount equal to number of valid entries
Verify presentCount and absentCount are correctly calculated
Verify savedRecords contains attendance records for all valid entries
Verify invalidEntries is empty
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount=2, presentCount=1, absentCount=1, savedRecords containing 2 records, invalidEntries empty

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Verify that marking batch attendance with empty list returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message

Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries

Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array containing valid and invalid attendance DTOs

Verify invalidEntries contains employeeIds of invalid entries
Verify presentCount and absentCount are correctly calculated for valid entries
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount=2, invalidEntries=[202], presentCount=1, absentCount=1

Title: Get all employees successfully
Description: Verify that the GET /api/employe endpoint returns a list of all employees.
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the database.
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe
Verify the response status is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains a list of employees
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with a JSON array of employee objects.

Title: Get employee by valid ID
Description: Verify that the GET /api/employe/{id} endpoint returns the employee details when a valid employee ID is provided.
Pre-Conditions: An employee with ID 1 exists in the database.
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/1
Verify the response status is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains the employee details with ID 1
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with employee details for ID 1.

Title: Get employee by non-existing ID
Description: Verify that the GET /api/employe/{id} endpoint returns an empty employee object when a non-existing employee ID is provided.
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/9999
Verify the response status is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains an empty employee object
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with an empty employee object.

Title: Create a new employee successfully
Description: Verify that the POST /api/employee endpoint creates a new employee when valid data is provided.
Pre-Conditions: No employee with the same ID exists.
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with valid employee data in the body
Verify the response status is 200 OK or 201 Created
Verify the employee is saved in the database
Expected Result: Employee is created successfully and persisted.

Title: Create employee with missing fields
Description: Verify that the POST /api/employee endpoint handles missing required fields gracefully.
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with an empty or incomplete employee object
Verify the response status is 200 OK or appropriate error if validation is implemented
Verify the employee is saved with default or null values or rejected
Expected Result: Employee is saved with null/default values or request is rejected if validation exists.

Title: Update existing employee successfully
Description: Verify that the PUT /api/employee/{id} endpoint updates an existing employee's details when valid data is provided.
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/1 with updated employee data in the body
Verify the response status is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains the updated employee details
Verify the employee data is updated in the database
Expected Result: Employee with ID 1 is updated successfully with new details.

Title: Update non-existing employee
Description: Verify that the PUT /api/employee/{id} endpoint returns 404 Not Found when trying to update a non-existing employee.
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/9999 with employee data in the body
Verify the response status is 404 Not Found
Expected Result: Response status 404 Not Found with no update performed.

Title: Delete existing employee successfully
Description: Verify that the DELETE /api/employee/{id} endpoint deletes an existing employee.
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/1
Verify the response status is 200 OK or 204 No Content
Verify the employee with ID 1 no longer exists in the database
Expected Result: Employee with ID 1 is deleted successfully.

Title: Delete non-existing employee
Description: Verify that the DELETE /api/employee/{id} endpoint handles deletion of a non-existing employee gracefully.
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/9999
Verify the response status is 200 OK or 204 No Content
Verify no error is thrown
Expected Result: Request completes successfully with no employee deleted.

Title: Create employee with maximum length name and role
Description: Verify that the POST /api/employee endpoint accepts employee data with maximum allowed length for name and role fields.
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with employee data containing MAX_NAME and MAX_ROLE strings
Verify the response status is 200 OK or 201 Created
Verify the employee is saved with the provided maximum length fields
Expected Result: Employee is created successfully with maximum length name and role.

Title: Update employee with partial fields
Description: Verify that the PUT /api/employee/{id} endpoint updates only the provided fields and retains others.
Pre-Conditions: An employee with ID 1 exists with known data.
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/1 with only the 'role' field updated
Verify the response status is 200 OK
Verify the employee's role is updated and other fields remain unchanged
Expected Result: Employee's role is updated; other fields remain unchanged.
